summary: STAK Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Chinese oilfield equipment maker, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing CFO and CTO transitions: Ms. Diana Li resigned as CFO effective October 31, 2026, and Mr. Ke Dennis Xu resigned as CTO the same day, with no stated disagreement. Mr. Xiaofei Han, a CICPA holder with roughly 20 years of audit and advisory experience at Deloitte and Marcum Bernstein Pinchuk, was appointed CFO effective November 1, 2026. No terms, consideration, advisors, or board recommendation are stated; the filing is an ordinary leadership-succession disclosure, so no deal mechanics or arbitrage angle applies, though the abrupt CFO/CTO turnover warrants governance monitoring.
